name: pgmpy-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is pgmpy, a Python library for probabilistic graphical models: directed
and undirected graphs and their independence structure, discrete factors and conditional probability
tables, discrete Bayesian and Markov networks, factor graphs, junction trees, Markov chains and dynamic
Bayesian networks, exact and approximate inference, sampling, independence assertions, and readers and
writers for several network file formats.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the discrete probabilistic-graphical-model core of pgmpy: the Python modules of pgmpy/base/, pgmpy/factors/ (its top-level modules and pgmpy/factors/discrete/), pgmpy/independencies/, pgmpy/readwrite/, pgmpy/sampling/ and pgmpy/utils/ (except pgmpy/utils/hf_hub.py), the pgmpy/models/ modules __init__, DiscreteBayesianNetwork, DiscreteMarkovNetwork, FactorGraph, JunctionTree, ClusterGraph, MarkovChain, NaiveBayes and DynamicBayesianNetwork, and the pgmpy/inference/ modules __init__, base, ExactInference, EliminationOrder, ApproxInference, mplp and dbn_inference, together with docs/guides/custom_model.md, io.md, probabilistic_inference.md and simulations.md, docs/api/base.rst, factors.rst, independencies.rst, inference.rst, models.rst and readwrite.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
